bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans affairs; appropriating money for a grant to Every Third Saturday; requiring reports.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EVERY THIRD SATURDAY.

(a) $50,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $50,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Every Third Saturday to provide veterans with emergency assistance. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) Every Third Saturday must report to the commissioner of veterans affairs and the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans affairs policy and finance no later than September 1, 2026, and by September 1, 2027. Each report must include, at a minimum, a detailed explanation of how the grant money was used and the number of veterans served by the program.
additions: (a) $50,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $50,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Every Third Saturday to provide veterans with emergency assistance. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) Every Third Saturday must report to the commissioner of veterans affairs and the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans affairs policy and finance no later than September 1, 2026, and by September 1, 2027. Each report must include, at a minimum, a detailed explanation of how the grant money was used and the number of veterans served by the program.
